description: Upload a base64 file as an attachment. voicemail: wav/mp3, max 20 MB, no object_id, the returned uuid serves as attachment_uuid in nurture voicemail steps. Returns uuid, url, file, relative_time.

company_id.description: Company that owns object_id; default: the authenticated company

object_id.description: Owner id per category: candidate, application, comment, job note or company; omit for voicemail
